_about: Discrete single-FOV scan (MANUAL_MAIN). For mosaic, set acquisition=mosaic and fill columns, rows, zoom (see example_mosaic.json). Optional stage_x_um/stage_y_um pin the mosaic center; omit both to use the live Fluoview stage. FOV = 509.117 µm / zoom. power_tol is ± relative OPO/IR tolerance (discrete only).
